parent_objective: design a bounded high-speed/late-reveal history-sensitive source repair
blocked_by: M1576 high-speed and late-reveal source families are history-null despite clean positives elsewhere

public_gates: M1578 must design one bounded high-speed/late history-source repair
M1578 must use history-sensitive acceptance before materialization
M1578 must include current-frame substitution controls
M1578 must include stop/synthesis fallback if repair would chase a single public gate
M1578 must keep implementation smoke, materialization, training, PPO, promotion, and private holdout blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs one bounded repair aimed at high-speed/late source-family history sensitivity after M1576 nulls
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no simulator run, history interventions, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design relaxes M1576 high-speed/late gates
stop if design does not make history sensitivity a primary acceptance criterion
stop if design routes directly to materialization, training, PPO, or private holdout
fallback_plan: admit one bounded implementation only if the design has concrete source-generation changes
route to branch synthesis if no concrete high-speed/late history source repair is justified
keep M1576 as public diagnostic evidence if high-speed/late remain null
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1577 admits one design-only high-speed/late source repair after M1576 nulls

admission_evidence: M1576 found clean history-sensitive anchors in two families but high-speed/late remain null
M1577 classifies the blocker as scenario sampling failure
allowed_updates: M1578 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation manifest if design admits it

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1578 is design-only but must preserve M1576 current-frame controls.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If a concrete high-speed/late repair cannot be designed, synthesize or stop instead of lowering source-diversity standards.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded source repair can be designed to generate high-speed or late-reveal anchors where wrong-history interventions affect closed-loop outcome.
success_criteria: design targets high-speed/late source-family history sensitivity directly
design keeps history-sensitive acceptance and current-frame controls primary
implementation smoke materialization training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export and self-ID claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design relaxes M1576 gates after result
design routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export actor-input changes candidate materialization or implementation without gates
decision_rule: M1578 passes if it designs a concrete high-speed/late history-source repair before implementation.
